issues.description: Several actionable technical/contractual recommendations are marked as "general background knowledge" (e.g. verifying SSO/autorizace, central access management and audit logs; requesting hosting/residency in acceptable jurisdiction). These are non‑trivial recommendations and currently lack explicit citations to the KB excerpts provided.
issues.required_fix: Add explicit citations to the relevant KB excerpts or internal sections that justify these recommendations (for example the parts of the AI‑101 guidance that discuss authentication/SSO, audit logging, data residency and DPA requirements), or rephrase them clearly as unreferenced general background guidance and keep them minimal.

issues.description: Opening sentence states the choice is governed by "three main criteria" (sensitivity, integration requirements, operational/budget availability) but no KB excerpt is cited to support this particular triage framing.
issues.required_fix: Either add a supporting citation from the KB (e.g. the institutional/integration/security selection criteria in the AI‑101 / institutional chapters) or change wording to a more clearly framed recommendation (e.g. "common criteria to consider include...") and cite supporting KB passages such as the sections about enterprise selection, DPA/SLA and integration.

issues.description: Some \cite keys contain leading spaces and one \cite{} uses multiple keys separated by a comma + space (e.g. \cite{kb_malinka_..., kb_ai_101_...}). This can cause LaTeX citation issues or fail style checks.
issues.required_fix: Normalize all citation keys inside each \cite{...} to a comma‑separated list without extra spaces and remove any leading/trailing spaces inside keys. Verify that every cited key matches an entry in the .bib file used for compilation.

issues.description: The section recommends initiating DPIA for student data (correct and cited to Malinka). However, it would be more consistent with earlier checklist material (previous sections/annexes) to point readers to the provided DPIA template (9.4) or the online repo for templates.
issues.required_fix: Add an explicit cross‑reference to the DPIA template in the appendices (9.4) or to the internal repository (ai.vut.cz) so readers know where to find the DPIA form and example.

issues.description: The 'Konkrétní kroky spolupráce s IT a právním oddělením' bullets are high‑level. Readers (guarantors/IT) may benefit from a short example of the 'krátký assessment' form fields or a minimal checklist of DPA/SLA items to request.
issues.required_fix: Either include a 1–2 sentence example of the minimal assessment form (fields: data types, user roles, integrations, expected retention, PII presence) or reference the checklist/template in the annexes/repo so implementers have a concrete artefact to use.

issues.description: The RAG note is appropriately cautious but remains generic. Practical, pedagogically relevant constraints (e.g. examples of what to exclude from indexation or minimal pseudonymization approaches) are not given.
issues.required_fix: Add 2–3 short, concrete examples (e.g. "do not index student photos or grade spreadsheets with direct identifiers; keep only hashed IDs and aggregated scores") or point to the RAG blueprint in the appendices (9.5) where such specifics are available.

suggested_edits.edit_instruction: Either add citations to KB passages that support the triage criteria (sensitivity, integration, operational/budget) or change wording to: "Typické kritéria při rozhodování zahrnují: ..." and cite AI‑101 and Malinka where selection/integration/security are discussed.

Replace the parenthetical '(general background knowledge)' with a citation to the KB section discussing authentication/SSO/audit (or to the institutional integration guidance). If a direct KB excerpt is not available, keep the sentence but preface it with 'Obecné doporučení:' and keep it concise.
Add an explicit pointer to the annex/template for DPA content (e.g. the DPA checklist in 9.5 or the DPIA template 9.4) or cite the KB page that lists key DPA points.

Add one concrete do/don't example for indexation of student data (e.g. 'DO pseudonymize student identifiers before indexing; DON’T index raw gradebooks with names') and reference the RAG blueprint (9.5) if available.
Remove leading/trailing spaces inside citation keys and use comma-separated keys without extra spaces. Verify that every key has a corresponding .bib entry.
